text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: us-east-1 inference hotpool 0 saturated -> elevated 429 rate across tiered-ratepolicy. Queue length spiked from 400 -> 3200 in 2m. Auto-scaler attempted scale but stopped. Root: 429s, throttles. Link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123/hotpool?orgId=1

olivia: seeing it too. hotpool0 GPU utilization 99%, backpressure stacking on requests with long seqs. 429 rate is at 18% of requests for gold+tier clients.

sam (oncall): i'm on it. paged. can someone confirm autoscaler logs? ping @raj for infra.

raj: digging into autoscaler. logs show scale_attempts hit max_concurrent_scale=2 and then abort due to nodegroup quota errors: 
```
ERROR autoscaler: failed scale up: nodegroups/quota_exceeded region=us-east-1 available_nodes=0 requested=4
```
Also token-refill metrics look weird — refill_rate for tier gold set to 0.5 tokens/sec in policy instead of intended 5.0.

olivia: whoa that refill_rate mismatch would make buckets drain fast under burst. can we patch policy to restore 5.0?

sam (oncall): hold on. don't patch yet until we confirm cascading effects. We saw fallback routing misconfigured last time. Stepwise: 1) lower tier caps for non-critical routes to reduce incoming load to hotpool 2) temporarily bump refill_rate to 5.0 for gold 3) force fallback to small-quant model for long-sequence jobs.

jess (CS): customer impact: two enterprise customers reporting elevated error rates in their ingestion pipelines. CS alerted them and asked for ETA. Please include sample error ratio for comms.

kai: timeline: queue growth started at 10:12:04 UTC, spike at 10:15:30. readiness probes for hotpath tasks started failing at 10:16:10.

eve: i'm preparing mitigation commands. plan to apply minimal changes: patch ratepolicy, scale down non-critical pools, and open hotpool drain for low-priority workloads. Exec commands ready: 
```
# patch ratepolicy
curl -X PATCH https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/ratepolicies/gold -d '{"refill_rate":5.0,"burst":200}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN"
# reduce non-critical route weight
rbacctl set-priority route=/batch-ingest priority=low
# force model fallback
redwoodctl route set fallback --route=/chat/long-seq --model=opt-4x-small
```

sam (oncall): do it in that order. i'll keep monitoring. @raj, can you open temporary quota request for nodegroup? also check cluster-autoscaler events.

raj: on it. Requesting emergency nodepool increase with cloud team; ETA 8-12m. Meanwhile pushing a manual scale to existing nodes (evict low-priority pods).

olivia: i'm going to reduce token window for silver/bulk tiers so they don't stomp hotpool. will run a dry-run first.

incident-bot: paging oncall escalation: sam -> raj at 10:18:50 UTC.

sam (oncall): applied patch to gold refill_rate=5.0 at 10:19:02 UTC. Observing queue length.

olivia: after patch, token metrics show refill increased; 429 rate dropped to 11% in 90s. GPU utilization still high.

raj: cloud responded. manual node add succeeded, added 2 GPU nodes to cluster at 10:26:30. autoscaler still limited by max_pools=5, we temporarily increased to 7.

eve: evicted 3 low-priority batch pods from hotpool nodes to free slots for inference, applied fallback route for long sequences.

jess (CS): update for customers: sent preliminary note: "We are actively mitigating an inference capacity incident causing transient 429 errors. We expect progressive recovery in <30m. We'll follow up with RCA."

sam (oncall): recovery looks underway. 429s down to 3%, queue drained to ~120. Hotpool SLA alerts cleared at 10:31:40.

olivia: putting a short-term rule in place: cap batch-ingest concurrency to 50 req/s per region until quota verified. Also scheduling a config rollback window in 24h to revert emergency increases.

raj: follow-ups: 1) infra request to permanently raise nodegroup quota 2) autoscaler tuning: increase max_concurrent_scale and better retry on quota errors 3) add CI test for ratepolicy typo detection (refill_rate units).

sam (oncall): handing off to raj for the post-incident runbook and RCA. tagging @eve for mitigation doc. If anything re-escalates ping me.

jess (CS): note: two customers reported brief outages, one requested incident timeline. I'll coordinate final customer comms once we have RCA.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (stabilized). Duration: ~19m. Severity: Sev2. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/1751234567

sam (oncall): final notes: root causes = (a) ratepolicy misconfig (refill_rate wrong units) (b) autoscaler hit quota and aborted scale ups (c) no protective cap on non-critical bulk routes. Immediate actions executed: refill_rate patch, emergency node add, low-priority eviction, fallback routing. Next: RCA, permanent quota increase, autoscaler retry improvements, policy lint.

raj: I'll own the RCA. Kickoff meeting 10:45 UTC.

olivia: will add a unit test to policy deploy pipeline to catch zero/incorrect refill_rate values.

eve: drafting mitigation timeline + commands into incident playbook.

jess (CS): adding customer impact summary to the incident ticket.

sam (oncall): thanks team. closing thread and moving to postmortems channel for RCA and timeline. :thumbsup:
